Two-way method: retain exact original decimal prices d1,d2, compute q_i=1/d_i and conditional p_i=q_i/(q1+q2). Both outcomes must belong to the same evidenced occurrence, participant orientation, exact line, period/overtime and applicable scoring/settlement condition. Store selected index, both native source prices/clocks, provider receipt hash and dependency revisions. Display selected-side actual Pinnacle odds; de-vig is the benchmark calculation, not replacement odds. This is a market benchmark estimate, not an independent model.

Explicit three-way method: only a retained same-market complete home/draw/away quote can support proportional normalization across all three. [Odds market catalog](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/betting-markets.html) documents `h2h_3_way`; configuration currently requests h2h/spreads/totals only. Registration of a draw product or binary tie contract is not three-way reference evidence. No additional acquisition or alternative de-vig/model method is qualified in this package.

Two prices cannot identify tie or integer-push mass. Let t be an independently evidenced tie probability: p_win=(1−t)c, p_loss=(1−t)(1−c), p_tie=t, where c is conditional decisive win probability. With unknown t show conditional decisive-result benchmark. With a sourced/calibrated estimate, label provenance and sensitivity; default t=0 is prohibited. Similarly use a separate independently evidenced push mass for integer lines. Cancellation/refund can remain a disclosed payout scenario without assigning arbitrary event probability. A feasible mutually exclusive exhaustive partition must be validated before a complete EV result; sum1 alone is insufficient.

Independent original inputs [machine vectors](comparison-r07-probability-vectors-20261008.json): decimal2 and3 imply1/2+1/3=5/6, then p=(3/5,2/5). $1 face at costs1/2,3/5,2/3 produces gross returns1/5,0,−1/10. Add an explicitly hypothetical nonrefundable1/8 charge at cost1/2: deployed capital5/8, expected profit3/5−5/8=−1/40 and net return−1/25. Thus costs can erase a positive gross edge; this is arithmetic, not an applicable fee rate. Explicit three-way2,4,4 produces1/2,1/4,1/4 over home/draw/away.

Tie sensitivity only: assume t=1/10 and c=3/5 → win27/50,loss9/25,tie1/10. A half-tie $1 face has expected payout27/50+1/20=59/100; at1/2 cost return9/50. At decimal2, $1 sportsbook stake with independently assumed push1/10 yields expected payout2×27/50+1/10=59/50 and return9/50. These assumptions have no observed probability authority and must not enter production ranking. A1/2 cancelled +1/2 abandoned partition can sum1 but be invalid because labels overlap.

Existing `current_benchmark.py` already uses exact Fraction arithmetic, a30-minute maximum source age, explicit conditional gross scope, and excludes not_win and integer-line attachment. Reuse exact gross path.30minutes is the existing pilot engineering policy, not provider accuracy warranty. Proposed D08 extension can retain useful integer/not_win conditional results only through deliberately typed payouts/conditioning; do not simply lift the exclusions. Both reference source clocks must be known and not future-dated; maximum side age≤1800seconds. Receipt, heartbeat and advertised update interval do not establish quote freshness. Expiry withholds EV ranking, leaving original prices inspectable.
